description:
## Goal

Ignite activation analysis from the exact absent-to-present Activation(key) movement through the same edge-triggered fact-production mechanism established by fz-kdt.46.

## Model

The movement demands ActivationAnalyzed(key). Re-evaluation follows the analysis job's standing Current(Activation) read. Retraction and reappearance use ordinary dependency edges. Do not add another pending queue or activation registry.

## TDD and deletion

Prove multiple activations, blocked first analysis, macros, self-recursion, retraction/reappearance, equal reproduction, deterministic causal work and artifacts. Delete World.activation_frontier, its HashSet clone/render/sort/retire loop, accessors, start telemetry, WorkStartReason variant, docs and probes.

## Acceptance

Every analysis start names its activation appearance or changed dependency. No normal-drive activation scan or display-derived scheduling remains. Unchanged/unrelated requests perform no activation work.
title: Ignite activation analysis from exact activation-appearance edges
